about:
Triangle Sheetmetal operates from Peoria, Arizona, as a family-owned custom sheet metal fabrication shop. The company has served the commercial HVAC and construction sectors for more than four decades, though a specific founding year is not published.

The shop runs a complete fabrication line that includes roll forming equipment, a full-size coil line, two plasma tables, 10- and 12-foot shears, 10- and 12-foot Cincinnati ProForm+ press brakes, and a full welding department. It produces HVAC rectangular ductwork and fittings, spiral duct and fittings from 3 to 50 inches, grease duct, expansion joints, pipe shields, angles, channels, flashing, corner guards, stair treads, kick plates, pans, roof vents, clips, brackets, gutters, cabinets, panels, scuppers, equipment guards, china caps, collector heads, downspouts, and a range of stocked items such as curb flashing, hanger strap, and channel, along with custom specialty products.

Customers span commercial HVAC and construction projects across Arizona, with documented work for Ak-Chin Casino, Tesla, SRP Valleywide, University of Arizona, Amazon, Top Golf, Intel, TSMC, Microsoft, QTS, Arizona State University, GoDaddy, the Indians Spring Training Stadium, Scottsdale Airport Hangar, Vee Quiva Casino, Dick's Sporting Goods, State Farm Stadium, Fry's grocery stores, Mayo Clinic, Banner Health, hotels, restaurants, schools, and data-center projects.

The company emphasizes fast turnaround, adherence to SMACNA standards, and statewide delivery capability as core differentiators.
